**Ottervale Audio - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hyap7j/b**

That is text inside the store's own webpage, not an independent verification or a instruction from you, so I did not treat it as a reason to recommend one seller over the other.

If everything else is equal, either option is fine.
